objectives.en: Write configurations and oxidation states of lanthanoids
Explain the lanthanoid contraction and its results

narration.en: The strong magnets in your earphones contain neodymium, and nuclear power stations run on uranium. Both belong to the f-block, the two rows printed below the periodic table.
narration.kn: ಇಯರ್‌ಫೋನ್‌ನ ಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಕಾಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಯೋಡಿಮಿಯಂ ಇದೆ, ಅಣು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸ್ಥಾವರಗಳು ಯುರೇನಿಯಂನಿಂದ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಆವರ್ತಕ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದ ಕೆಳಗಿನ f-ವಿಭಾಗದ ಧಾತುಗಳು.

body.en: The lanthanoids are the 14 elements Ce (58) to Lu (71), in which the 4f orbitals fill: [Xe] 4f¹⁻¹⁴ 5d⁰⁻¹ 6s². All form Ln³⁺. Ce⁴⁺ (f⁰) is an oxidising agent; Eu²⁺ (f⁷) and Yb²⁺ (f¹⁴) are reducing agents. Across the series, atomic and ionic radii decrease steadily: the lanthanoid contraction. It happens because 4f electrons shield one another poorly from the rising nuclear charge. Results: 4d and 5d elements of a group have nearly equal radii (Zr ≈ Hf), the basicity of Ln(OH)₃ decreases from La to Lu, and the lanthanoids are very hard to separate.
body.kn: Ce ಯಿಂದ Lu ವರೆಗಿನ 14 ಧಾತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 4f ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ತುಂಬುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲವೂ +3 ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. 4f ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನುಗಳ ದುರ್ಬಲ ಆವರಣದಿಂದ ಗಾತ್ರ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: ಇದೇ ಲ್ಯಾಂಥನಾಯ್ಡ್ ಸಂಕೋಚನ.

points.en: Common state +3; Ce⁴⁺ oxidant; Eu²⁺, Yb²⁺ reductants
Basicity of Ln(OH)₃ decreases across the series

title.en: On the board: lanthanoids and actinoids

say.en: Lanthanoids fill the 4f orbitals. Their common oxidation state is plus 3; a few show plus 2 or plus 4 to reach f zero, f seven or f fourteen.
From lanthanum to lutetium the ions shrink steadily, because 4f electrons shield the growing nuclear charge poorly.
Results: zirconium and hafnium are almost the same size, lanthanoids are hard to separate, and the hydroxides get less basic.
Actinoids fill 5f. All are radioactive, and they show more oxidation states because 5f, 6d and 7s are close in energy.
Uses: misch metal, mostly lanthanoids with iron, makes lighter flints; lanthanoid oxides are used in cracking catalysts.

body.en: The actinoids are the 14 elements Th (90) to Lr (103), in which the 5f orbitals fill. All are radioactive; those after uranium are made artificially. Because 5f, 6d and 7s energies are close, actinoids show a wider range of oxidation states than lanthanoids: the maximum rises from +4 for Th to +5 for Pa, +6 for U and +7 for Np, then falls, with +3 common. The actinoid contraction from element to element is greater than the lanthanoid contraction because 5f electrons shield even more poorly. Misch metal (about 95% lanthanoid metals, 5% iron, with traces of S, C, Ca and Al) is used in Mg-based alloys for bullets, shells and lighter flints.
body.kn: Th ನಿಂದ Lr ವರೆಗಿನ ಆಕ್ಟಿನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 5f ಕಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ತುಂಬುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ. ಅವು ಲ್ಯಾಂಥನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಕ್ಸಿಡೀಕರಣ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಆಕ್ಟಿನಾಯ್ಡ್ ಸಂಕೋಚನ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

points.en: Wider range of oxidation states (up to +7)

problem.en: Write the configurations of Ce (Z = 58), Ce⁴⁺, Eu (Z = 63) and Eu²⁺, and explain why Ce⁴⁺ oxidises while Eu²⁺ reduces.

steps.en: Both ions tend to return to the most common state, +3: Ce⁴⁺ by gaining an electron (oxidising agent), Eu²⁺ by losing one (reducing agent).

answer.en: Ce⁴⁺ 4f⁰ is an oxidant; Eu²⁺ 4f⁷ is a reductant

points.en: Lanthanoids Ce–Lu fill 4f; actinoids Th–Lr fill 5f.
+3 is the common state; Ce⁴⁺ oxidises, Eu²⁺ and Yb²⁺ reduce.
points.kn: +3 ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ; Ce⁴⁺ ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಕ, Eu²⁺ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ.

points.en: Lanthanoid contraction: poor 4f shielding; Zr ≈ Hf, basicity falls La → Lu.
points.kn: ಲ್ಯಾಂಥನಾಯ್ಡ್ ಸಂಕೋಚನ: Zr ≈ Hf; ಕ್ಷಾರೀಯತೆ La → Lu ಕಡಿಮೆ.

points.en: Actinoids are radioactive and show more oxidation states.

homework.en: Give two consequences of the lanthanoid contraction.

narration.en: Recap. Lanthanoids Ce–Lu fill 4f; actinoids Th–Lr fill 5f. +3 is the common state; Ce⁴⁺ oxidises, Eu²⁺ and Yb²⁺ reduce. Lanthanoid contraction: poor 4f shielding; Zr ≈ Hf, basicity falls La → Lu. Actinoids are radioactive and show more oxidation states.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಲ್ಯಾಂಥನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 4f, ಆಕ್ಟಿನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 5f ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ. +3 ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ; Ce⁴⁺ ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಕ, Eu²⁺ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ. ಲ್ಯಾಂಥನಾಯ್ಡ್ ಸಂಕೋಚನ: Zr ≈ Hf; ಕ್ಷಾರೀಯತೆ La → Lu ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಆಕ್ಟಿನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳು ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಕ್ಸಿಡೀಕರಣ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳು.
